about_the_game:
Send your party members to school to master their powers and compete with other groups with the Heroine Character Generator 11 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft is back with another pack of generator parts to help your heroines dress their best. 62 new parts offer up a variety of options to help you fill your modern worlds with even more characters. Give your heroine slightly pointed ears to hint at a magical heritage, let the city’s different schools each have unique uniforms, and suit up in dark green tactical gear when it’s time to defeat evil!

3 AccA, 9 AccB, 1 Cloak, 20 Clothing, 1 Ear, 3 Eyebrows, 5 Eyes, 1 Face, 2 Glasses, 5 Mouths, 2 Noses, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair pieces are perfect for creating distinct party members and NPCs who can travel across the game world, strike a pose in battle, yell during cutscenes, and more! Let your heroine dress differently depending on the time of day and what she’s up to by having her wear a school uniform and a cute flower in her hair when attending lessons, and relax in a track suit and baseball cap during her off time. Create a princess NPC with long flowing hair and a gorgeous kimono with bright eyes who shows her emotions through the tilt of her eyebrows. This pack also includes updated grad_common and grad_eyes images so you can give your characters some new color palettes to make them stand out even more. If you’ve been searching for some more school uniforms or just need a few more expressions for your party members to make during dramatic cutscenes, check out the Heroine Character Generator 11 for MZ pack!


This pack includes:

・Face: 1
・Eyebrow: 3
・Eyes: 5
・Ears: 1
・Nose: 2
・Mouth: 5
・Accessories x12
・Glasses: 2
・Cloak: 1
・Front Hair: 5
・Rear Hair: 5
・Clothes: 20


※Please read before purchasing※

This generator material comes with an optimized base body, so please save the default base body in a separate local folder, etc., and then store the optimized base body in each generator folder.



Terms of Use:

* This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
* OK to be used in Commercial projects
* Contents can be edited
* OK for use in games with gore
* OK for use in adult-rated games
